test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
​​​Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e587c5a005a6bac1bd03a37202970a73603d5681cbf982bee57414b5f9dc4e8f.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: KM - SV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566ff5663ec13e5b129207fa70105988aa96d35fd7c8315cde58711a969581a5.png] 

Option 2: EG - MO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5eadec2d361c21a82e0058d44481de869d0826c4b93eac0f68e7d491b1df2f5.png] 

Option 3: CE - KM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad93ffb3434db91443aeeabf88471a33d462bc4ef3c46f715d63df66f8e414e.png] 

Option 4: BD - JL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0afdd0b05dcb7b975ce91c8a1efb5dc98e044fc99eb07b7684a72f883b98dc75.png] 

Thus, KM - SV does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
